patterns.note: The site uses a clean, image-centric grid layout for portfolio items and stories, with full-bleed hero imagery at the top of the page.
A consistent, legible sans-serif typeface is used across all text elements, maintaining a professional and understated feel.
The primary color palette is minimalist, relying on a high-contrast combination of dark text on light backgrounds, allowing the rich photography to provide visual interest.
The header navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid background to become a sticky element at the top of the viewport.
Content sections are clearly delineated by large, descriptive headings and organized into distinct grids for 'Featured Work' and 'Stories'.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed background image with overlaid text, creating an immersive initial impression.
The main navigation bar is initially transparent and full-height, then transitions to a smaller, sticky bar with a solid white background as the user scrolls down the page.
Content is presented in a responsive grid system, ensuring images and text blocks adapt gracefully to different screen sizes.

design_tokens.type_scale: A balanced type scale with clear hierarchy; headings are moderately larger than body text, maintaining readability without being overly dominant.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its strong emphasis on high-quality, full-bleed architectural photography, which serves as the primary visual language. The minimalist UI ensures the focus remains on the project imagery, creating an elegant and professional portfolio presentation.
